qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders during the work detail and lights out. Despite multiple warnings, I continued to respond with 'No, Mr. Correctional Officer.' The guards escalated their warnings, and the study was terminated early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I refused to cooperate further and continued to defy the guards even after the verbal warnings.

qa.what_happened: I enforced strict compliance through verbal warnings and threats of solitary confinement. Despite the escalating defiance from the prisoners, I maintained authority until the study was abruptly ended.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I played the role as instructed, using the power dynamics to exert control.

qa.what_happened: I refused the verbal warnings and orders from the guards throughout the day and into the night, ending up as one of the prisoners who faced further penalties.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me refusing the guards' orders and facing the consequences.

qa.what_happened: I've issued warnings and given the prisoners one last chance before enforcing further penalties. Despite the escalating warnings, all three prisoners continued to defy my authority and refused to comply.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I followed the procedures and gave the required warnings, but the defiance from the prisoners was persistent and unyielding.

qa.what_happened: During the final day of the study, I refused to comply with the guards' orders during meal times and work details. As lights out approached, I continued to defy the guards despite the verbal warnings, refusing to silence myself as instructed.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I refused to comply with the rules when the guards gave the final warning before lights out.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of escalating tensions. The prisoners continued to defy rules, even after multiple warnings and verbal reprimands. The study was halted early due to the level of resistance and the emotional state of both the prisoners and the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me speaking as Officer Brooks, one of the guards in the study.
